svg.title: Fictional sample COA - AN-7K9Q-2M4X
svg.desc: Single-page portrait report with fixed fictional sample data, illustrative chromatogram and mass spectra, and the Dylan Greene handwritten signature at the lower left. Lookup Code AN-7K9Q-2M4X. An illustrative vial image appears beside the analytical results. Footer QR opens https://assaynovalabs.com/coa/AN-7K9Q-2M4X/report.pdf
